title: Doping effect of antimony on BaFeO3 perovskite oxide: optical, electronic, magnetic and thermoelectric properties

The computed figure of merit (ZT ≈ 0.50) shows significant enhancement after 25% Sb-doping. In particular, the 25% Sb-doped sample shows a reduction in the optical absorption and offers an enhanced optical transparency in the visible region.
